Always use this skill for "ceph health", "what does this HEALTH_WARN mean", "PG_DEGRADED / OSD_NEARFULL / SLOW_OPS / MON_DOWN", "ceph -s", "which OSD is most full", "drain an OSD", "purge an OSD", "stuck PGs", "overdue scrub", "pool usable capacity", "set pool size / quota", "rebalance is too slow / throttle backfill", "RBD image or snapshot", "MDS behind on trimming", "RGW large omap", "mon quorum", or "days to nearfull" when the context is a Ceph cluster (cephadm, hypervisor-bundled Ceph, or MicroCeph). Do NOT use when the target is not Ceph — a hypervisor, a different storage appliance, a backup product, a Kubernetes cluster, or a network device. Route those to the appropriate other AIops-tools skill (negative routing hint only). Common Ceph ops with a built-in governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers).
